name: qun-agent-bridge
description: Connect Claude Desktop to browser tabs approved by the user through a local MCP bridge.
long_description: QUN Agent Bridge is a local-first browser integration. It can check connection status, list tabs when the user grants the optional tabs permission, read text from a website explicitly approved in the browser extension, and open HTTP or HTTPS URLs. It does not click page controls, submit forms, make purchases, send messages, or run arbitrary shell commands.

bridge_token.title: Browser bridge token
bridge_token.description: Enter the same 64-character token already saved in the QUN Agent Bridge Chrome extension. Sensitive values are stored by Claude Desktop in the operating system's secure credential store.
